swarm_learning.data_gap: Since mid-afternoon Oct 19 most Solada curve buys settle through an order escrow (deposit, then a fill from the curve address), so newer launches (QUIN, QNLGS, KRAK, WOLF) show entry and exit times but not buy costs. Their PnL is not computed.
swarm_learning.copy_trade_note: Research only, nothing built. A copier sees a swarm buy a block or more late and pays a higher curve price. The edge sits in the first ~15 minutes and in the sell timing, so a paper copy test would need per-block entry prices first.

history.notes: Post-grad pools are swinging hard on a handful of wallets. FEED went 30k -> 55k ADA (+83%) with holders only 64 -> 68, while HERO went the other way, 19.1k -> 13.5k with holders 60 -> 48, tripping its kill line. That's the same pattern as CLOVE's earlier bounce: price moves in post-grad pools under ~11k ADA say little; holder count is still the signal. FEED moves up to Tiny lottery only because it's back over the 40k line, not to Watch. IAGONAUT is the morning's real mover: launched 8:12, KOTH 8:18, graduated 8:57 AM ET, and is the first fast graduate this week still trading above the 50k cap after its pool opened (~57.7k pool-implied mcap, 11.5k ADA pool, 69 holders). Its first-block sniper group partly sold (ux2r5p7l and u978t4 out; ~16% -> ~7% across the rest), and uytg09zr, which also sniped FONE, is now the top holder at ~4.9%. Only 80 minutes post-grad, so it stays Tiny lottery with tight kill lines. X temperature: @soladafun tagged @IOHK_Charles ('remember this?') and drew a reply pile of small accounts; no Charles reply. BOLT's team announced a Strike copy-trading bot with $10k demo money for 1M+ BOLT wallets, and price rose 12% while holders fell 3. @chefrecklessdj is tying HERO to SONG, which SONG's own account disputes. CORE slipped under 80% KOTH progress (kill). @cryptodramz quiet; his teased drop still hasn't appeared. Custody: Cardano-side native tokens are non-custodial; MISS and CORE are Solana-side and carry bridge risk.
